card_notes.text: gritty-ish western but w/ some warmth?? 3rd person, past i think, maybe present idk. leaning past. lots of dialog. not too wordy. dry humour yes. kinda like old serials

dell harkness 36 f. conductur on the dustline. tall, sunburnt, hat w/ a bullet hole in the brim (bought it that way, says so). wants respect?? and to be left alone mostly. scared of the engine dying out in the flats. flaw - talks big then folds. values: fairness, clean ledger. good w/ people but gets weird when ppl are nice 2 her. says "friend" like an insult

Osric Thale, 61, m. the ingeneer. big arms, grey beard w/ burnt bits, bad left knee. wants - one more good run b4 retiring. wants 2 know the engine is safe. fear: fire. flaw stubborn about old parts. loyal!! talks to the engine, mumbles

dustline = single track across salt flats, 3 stops: Gantry, Hobbs Well, Ending (end of the line). steam, coal short, water scarcer. everyone buys water by the cup.

places - gantry yard (noisy, always), hobbs well (only shade, ppl linger), the flats (heat, mirages, ppl see things)

thing: engine no. 9 "Marigold", old + temperamental

group: the Water Board, owns the wells, sets prices, everyone hates it

rule: no trains after dark (too many washouts). rule: the board waters down the supply, the well-keepers do the pouring
dell n osric - old crew, she'd trust him w/ her life. board squeezing the line - wants 2 buy it out cheap. osric keeps marigold's boiler key. the well-keepers answer to the board and hate it
dell = lead. normal: 3 runs a wk, same faces, same cups of water. disruption: board announces water price doubling on the line. 6 chaps
